task.title: Find the goroutines internal/cli's command tests leave behind
task.description: Measured on feat/cli-test-speed (PR #153) while checking a go test -count=2 run of internal/cli: the second iteration cost 207 s against 127 s for a single run, and a goroutine census inside TestMain showed about 455 goroutines before the first iteration and about 1790 before the second, so roughly 1300 outlive the tests that started them, one to three per ordinary command test. The branch's re-review located the culprit in the product's command path, not the tests: projection.Store holds a *sql.DB, internal/projection defines no Close on Store, and internal/cli calls projection.Open at eleven sites without closing one, so every command leaves database/sql's connection-opener goroutines behind. A long-lived workbook serve or the desktop's watcher runs commands in one process the same way, so this leaks in the product too. Fix: give Store a Close that closes the DB, close it at every internal/cli call site (a helper that opens and defers is the obvious shape), and add a test that counts goroutines across one command and finds none left behind.
